mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lab_equipment_reserve (equipment_id, equipment_name, user_id, user_name, reserve_quantity, reserve_date, start_time, end_time, status, purpose, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{equipmentId}, #{equipmentName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userId}, #{userName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COALESCE(#{reserveQuantity}, 1), #{reserveDate}, #{startTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{endTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, COALESCE(#{status}, 0), #{purpose,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE lab_equipment_reserve SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE lab_equipment_reserve SET is_used = #{isUsed}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM lab_equipment_reserve ORDER BY create_time DESC
